reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Allow the Go runtime to dynamically set `GOMAXPROCS` by @stefanprodan in https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/pull/5501", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Flux controllers now dynamically adjust the Go runtime's processor thread limits to respond to available system resources, which may improve CPU utilization and performance in containerized environments.

proposed.statement: The Go runtime in Flux can now dynamically set GOMAXPROCS to adapt CPU resource utilization at runtime.
